items.markdown:
Product metrics are `quantifiable data points that measure a product's performance, user behavior, and business success`.[[1]](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/product-management/product-metrics)[[2]](https://www.productplan.com/learn/product-metrics-matter)

### Core Categories of Product Metrics

- **Acquisition:** Tracks how many new users find and sign up for your product, alongside the [Customer Acquisition Cost](https://amplitude.com/blog/product-metrics-guide) (CAC).
- **Activation:** Measures how fast users reach their "aha moment" and experience the product's core value for the first time.
- **Engagement:** Monitors active usage via Daily, Weekly, or Monthly Active Users (DAU/WAU/MAU) and product "stickiness" (DAU/MAU ratio).
- **Retention:** Counts the percentage of users who keep coming back over time versus those who leave (churn rate).
- **Monetization:** Evaluates financial health through metrics like Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV).[[1]](https://productschool.com/blog/analytics/metrics-product-management)[[2]](https://amplitude.com/blog/product-metrics-guide)[[3]](https://www.gainsight.com/essential-guide/product-management-metrics/)[[4]](https://www.heap.io/topics/product-metrics-kpis)

### Best Practices for Tracking

- **Focus on a North Star:** Align your team around one primary metric that captures core value delivery.
- **Avoid Vanity Metrics:** Skip numbers that look impressive on paper (like total page views) but do not drive real action or revenue.
- **Balance Leading and Lagging:** Pair short-term leading indicators (like feature adoption) with long-term lagging indicators (like revenue).[[1]](https://amplitude.com/blog/product-metrics-guide)[[2]](https://www.gainsight.com/essential-guide/product-management-metrics/)[[3]](https://www.productplan.com/learn/product-metrics-matter)[[4]](https://www.heap.io/topics/product-metrics-kpis)[[5]](https://www.glassbox.com/blog/product-metrics-kpis/)

If you want, tell me:

- What is your **product type** (B2B SaaS, mobile app, e-commerce)?
- What is your **current growth stage** (early-stage launch or scaling)?

I can recommend a tailored list of key metrics for your specific project.
